name: Sumita (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Sumita town emblem in yellow: a winged ring enclosing a small ring.
history: Municipal flag of Sumita, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1956.

features.role: Sumita town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a small ring
